SELECT p.id ,p.pool_name ,p.pool_type ,p.market_codes ,p.variety_codes ,p.description ,p.max_capacity ,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stock_code) FROM ip_pool_status_stock ps WHERE ps.target_pool_id = p.id AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0) AS current_count FROM ip_investment_pool p
AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND JSON_CONTAINS(p.variety_codes, '"stock"') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 )
AND p.id IN
#{poolId}
ORDER BY p.outer_sort ASC ,p.inner_sort ASC ,p.id ASC

SELECT si.* ,dst.security_type_name ,(SELECT sr.rating_code FROM rrs_stock_rating sr WHERE sr.stock_code = si.stock_code AND sr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sr.rating_date DESC ,sr.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_rating ,(SELECT sr.rating_code FROM rrs_stock_rating sr WHERE sr.stock_code = si.stock_code AND sr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sr.rating_date DESC ,sr.id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS previous_rating FROM rrs_stockinfo si INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = si.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'stock' AND dst.is_deleted = 0
AND si.is_deleted = 0 AND si.security_status = 'L' AND si.market_code IN ('SSE', 'SZSE', 'HKEX') AND (si.delist_date IS NULL OR si.delist_date > NOW())
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status_stock ps WHERE ps.stock_code = si.stock_code AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status_stock ps WHERE ps.stock_code = si.stock_code AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 )
AND si.stock_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{stockCode}, '%')
AND (si.stock_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{stockName}, '%') OR si.stock_short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{stockName}, '%'))
AND si.stock_short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{stockShortName}, '%')
AND si.industry_code = #{industryCode}
AND si.market_code = #{marketCode}
AND si.security_type = #{securityType}
ORDER BY si.stock_code ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND JSON_CONTAINS(p.variety_codes, '"stock"') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 )
